About Us

Technology That Works For You

Lexnova Technologies is a premier technology company based in Bauchi State, Nigeria, dedicated to delivering exceptional digital solutions for businesses and individuals. Founded on the principles of innovation, reliability, and security, we have established ourselves as a trusted partner for organizations seeking to leverage technology for growth.

Our team of skilled professionals brings together expertise in software development, web technologies, database management, and IT infrastructure. Whether you are a startup or an established enterprise, we have the skills and experience to turn your vision into reality.

Empower businesses with innovative, reliable technology.

Meet the Founder

The driving force behind Lexnova Technologies' commitment to excellence and innovation.

Since 2020

Stephen Leka Theophilus

Founder & Chief Executive Officer

Stephen Leka Theophilus is a passionate technology leader with a National Diploma in Computer Science and also a Higher National Diploma in Software and Web Development from Federal Polytechnic, Bauchi, and hands-on experience across software development, web technologies, and IT infrastructure.

With a background that includes roles at Unity Bank PLC, INEC Nigeria, and the Sanitation and Hygiene Fund, Stephen brings a unique blend of technical expertise, field experience, and client-focused problem solving to every project.
